description: Read a person's year 2027 from their own chart: their numerology personal year and its theme, the year's theme from where Jupiter and Saturn move through their chart, which months are for moving and which for rest (each month labeled Move, Build, Steady or Rest), how many dates in 2027 touch their own chart and the first of them, with a link that opens their free 2027 preview already filled in. Use when someone asks "what does 2027 hold for me", "my 2027 horoscope", "my year ahead", "best months next year" or "my personal year in 2027". The sky is searched in an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris. birth_time and birth_place are optional; without them areas of life count from the Sun sign and the result says so. Themes and timing for reflection, never a promise.

birth_place.description: Birthplace as city, region, country, e.g. Austin, Texas, United States. Gives coordinates (and the time zone if time_zone is left out).

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude, if the city is not found. Optional.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude (east positive), with latitude. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago. Work it out from the birthplace. Needed with a birth_time unless birth_place is in our list.
